name: soia-meta
description: Skill ecosystem manager: searches the whole SOIA catalog by need and loads the right skill, syncs skills into the AI tools you choose, drives marketplace release after a merge, and drafts or diagnoses prompts.

displayDescription.en: Searches the whole catalog by need, syncs skills into the AI tools you choose, drives release after a merge, and drafts prompts.
displayDescription.zh: 按需求检索全生态技能并载入，把技能同步到你选的 AI 工具，跑发布收尾，并起草与诊断提示词。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I do not know which skill I need — describe my problem and find the right one for me.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我不知道该用哪个技能，我说需求，你帮我找到对的那个并载入。

quickPrompts.en: I do not know which skill I need — describe my problem and find the right one for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 我不知道该用哪个技能，我说需求，你帮我找到对的那个并载入。

quickPrompts.en: Sync these skills into the AI tools I use.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这几个技能同步到我在用的 AI 工具里。

quickPrompts.en: A skill change just merged — run the release and update my clients.
quickPrompts.zh: 技能改动刚合并了，帮我跑发布并更新客户端。
